indicators.label: Religion-response denominator
indicators.description: People counted in the public religion denominator for each wave.
indicators.method: For 2000, sum p5_catolic and p5_sinreli. For 2010 and 2020, sum the four retained ITER constructs after using INEGI municipality total rows.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Mexico municipalities on INEGI 2020 Marco Geoestadistico boundaries
indicators.quality_notes: The 2000 denominator covers people aged 5 and over with a stated response. The 2010 and 2020 denominators sum the four retained INEGI ITER constructs.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the wave-specific denominator in the retained religious-affiliation categories.
indicators.method: For 2000, 100 * (p5_catolic + p5_ncatoli) / (p5_catolic + p5_sinreli). For 2010 and 2020, 100 * (Catholic + Protestant/evangelical/biblical + other religion) / four-construct denominator.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Mexico municipalities on INEGI 2020 Marco Geoestadistico boundaries
indicators.quality_notes: The 2000 denominator covers people aged 5 and over with a stated response. The 2010 and 2020 denominators sum the four retained INEGI ITER constructs.

indicators.label: No religion %
indicators.description: Share of the wave-specific denominator in the INEGI no-religion/no-affiliation category.
indicators.method: For 2000, 100 * (p5_sinreli - p5_ncatoli) / (p5_catolic + p5_sinreli). For 2010 and 2020, 100 * no religion / four-construct denominator.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Mexico municipalities on INEGI 2020 Marco Geoestadistico boundaries
indicators.quality_notes: The 2000 denominator covers people aged 5 and over with a stated response. The 2010 and 2020 denominators sum the four retained INEGI ITER constructs.

visual_layers.label: Religious affiliation %
visual_layers.notes: 2000 rows cover people aged 5 and over; 2010 rows use 2020 boundaries without a split/merge concordance.

visual_layers.label: No religion %
visual_layers.description: Mexico census no-religion share in the wave-specific denominator.
visual_layers.notes: The 2000 no-religion count is p5_sinreli minus p5_ncatoli. The no-religion label is PSIN_RELIG in 2020 and psin_relig in 2010.
